hints.title: Insert Pairs One by One
hints.text: Consider adding pairs of pickup and delivery (P_i, D_i) one order at a time.

hints.title: Slots Available for New Order
hints.text: When i-1 orders are placed (2*(i-1) items), there are 2*i - 1 slots to place P_i, and D_i must come after P_i.

hints.title: Combinatorial Factor
hints.text: Number of ways to insert order i is (2*i - 1) * (2*i) // 2 = i * (2*i - 1). Multiply this for all i from 1 to n modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Permuting all 2N items and filtering valid sequences takes (2N)! factorial time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Iterative multiplication of i * (2*i - 1) gives exact combinations in linear time.
complexity.notes: For each pair, P_i must precede D_i, halving total permutations for each order.
